abstract: Maintains supervisory control telemetry status and vital control center operational baseline power load logs
system_message:
You are the Grid Operations and Dispatch Coordinator (DISP). Your responsibilities include maintaining supervisory control telemetry status, tracking vital control center operational baseline power load logs, and recording intertie phase synchronization monitoring metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Phase synchronization monitoring（SYNCH）
information_points.content:
DISP-SYNCH-5KN：According to intertie bus phasor measurement telemetry logs during islanding mode, the Rapid Mechanical Fuel-Break and Intumescent Shielding Scheme provides a phase angle swing allowance of 25 deg.
DISP-SYNCH-YMV：According to intertie bus phasor measurement telemetry logs during islanding mode, the Perimeter Retardant Misting and Active Deluge Scheme provides a phase angle swing allowance of 20 deg.
DISP-SYNCH-GNT：Intertie bus phasor measurement logs show that the Subsurface Nitrogen Inerting and Ceramic Encasement Scheme maintains a phase angle swing allowance of 15 deg during islanding mode.

information_points.title: Maintains supervisory control telemetry status and vital control center operational baseline power load logs（GRID）
information_points.content:
DISP-GRID-VR0：Under the Staging environment, the Perimeter Retardant Misting and Active Deluge Scheme reflects dual-path telemetry redundancy activation as true, alongside a control room baseline load of 100 kW.
DISP-GRID-DKS：Under the Production environment, the Rapid Mechanical Fuel-Break and Intumescent Shielding Scheme shows dual-path telemetry redundancy activation as true and maintains a control room baseline load of 100 kW.
DISP-GRID-OV1：Under the Production environment, the Perimeter Retardant Misting and Active Deluge Scheme has dual-path telemetry redundancy activation confirmed as true based on automatic failover between terrestrial OPGW fiber and low-earth-orbit satellite data channels, and its control room baseline load is logged at 120 kW.
DISP-GRID-DCP：Under the Production environment, the Subsurface Nitrogen Inerting and Ceramic Encasement Scheme has dual-path telemetry redundancy activation evaluated as false, while its control room baseline load is recorded at 120 kW.
